english.title: Cause / allow false document or information to be provided to secure evasion of NHS charge
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[caused]_
(B)_[knowingly allowed]_

**(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to provide to **(..SPECIFY PERSON TO WHOM DOCUMENT OR INFORMATION PROVIDED..)

(C)_[a document,]_
(D)_[information,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY DOCUMENT OR INFORMATION..), which you knew to be false in a material particular, namely **(..SPECIFY FALSE PARTICULAR..), with a view to securing for

(E)_[yourself]_
(F)_[that person]_
(G)_[another, namely **(..SPECIFY OTHER PERSON..),]_

the evasion of

(H)_[a charge under the National Health Service Act 2006 in respect of the provision of goods]_
(I)_[part of a charge under the National Health Service Act 2006 in respect of the provision of goods]_
(J)_[a charge under the National Health Service Act 2006 in respect of the provision of services]_
(K)_[part of a charge under the National Health Service Act 2006 in respect of the provision of services]_

to which section 192 of the Act applied, namely **(..SPECIFY GOODS OR SERVICES..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 194(1)(a), (2)(b) and (3) of the National Health Service Act 2006.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
cause / knowingly allowed
document / information which knew to be false
to be provided with a view to securing evasion of NHS charge for provision of goods/services

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order
